source_sha_policy: Production must serve the exact immutable homepage source SHA and preserve independently verifiable route, metadata and artifact receipts.

data_contract.policy: Evidence before amplification; every metric requires a dated snapshot; duplicate URLs collapse at runtime; private, minor, legal, financial and quarantined records are excluded from the public universe.

release_intent: Publish an Igor-first personal homepage from a provider-independent static artifact, preserve the source-linked archive, and remove any AppDeploy runtime requirement.
promotion_gate: The release is accepted only after the immutable repository artifact passes the release gate, contains no AppDeploy runtime dependency, and 7ya.io serves build marker igor-personal-independent-static-20260918-v2 across the critical routes.
rollback: The prior Tactical Ontology and History Song source commits remain available as immutable rollback references.
